title: Running feel and running costs
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly discuss enjoyable or smooth driving feel and economical running costs, with a few complaints about extra charges or cost-cutting changes and many fragments too brief to classify confidently.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise smooth or satisfying running performance and economical day-to-day running costs.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on frustration with extra charges and perceived cost-cutting removals rather than driving feel itself.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments often mention running, running costs, or joy in very short terms that suggest a theme but do not provide enough context for reliable sentiment classification.

limitations: Many sampled fragments are very short, which limits confidence in sentiment interpretation.
The topic mixes two related but distinct ideas: driving/running feel and operating costs.
Examples are insufficient to describe finer differences by market beyond noting that both GB and JP fragments appear in the sample.
